info.title: API.SH: Hotline.ua
info.description: The Hotline.ua API from API.SH: public Hotline.ua data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
What Hotline.ua's search box suggests for a query: suggested searches with their listing links, matching categories and products (with image).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotline-autocomplete

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Hotline.ua's category menu: every department, group and category with id, title, link and path, or one branch when `id` is given. Paths work with the category endpoints.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotline-categories

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Return only this menu item and its children.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products in a Hotline.ua category with the category's filters (value ids from the filters endpoint, included or excluded), a price range and the site's sorts. Same product card as search, plus the category's product count (or the filtered count). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotline-category

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Category link or path on hotline.ua.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Comma-separated filter value ids from /hotline/v1/category/filters, e.g. `3022,61425`.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Comma-separated filter value ids to leave out.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default popularity; quantity = most offers).

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: kyiv (default), lviv, kharkiv, odesa, dnipro, zaporizhzhia or a numeric city id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every filter group of a Hotline.ua category (brand, price, and each specification) with value ids, titles, aliases, descriptions and product counts, recalculated for the filters already chosen. Pass value ids to the category endpoint as `filters` or `exclude`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotline-category-filters

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Already chosen value ids (comma-separated), to get counts for the next choice.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Hotline.ua shop offers for a product
get.description:
Every shop's offer for a product on Hotline.ua: shop name, id, logo, website, rating and review counts, official-seller flag, price in UAH, condition, offer title and description, warranty, when it ships, where it ships from, delivery methods and costs, payment methods, instalments and the shop's stores, plus the link to the offer.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotline-offers

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Only new or only used/refurbished offers.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: kyiv (default), lviv, kharkiv, odesa, dnipro, zaporizhzhia or a numeric city id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A product's price history on Hotline.ua twice a month since it appeared: average, lowest and highest price in UAH and USD, the number of offers and popularity over time, the current lowest price, seller count and price change over 14 and 30 days, 3 and 6 months, a year and all time.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotline-price-history

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One product on Hotline.ua: title, brand, category, type, model line, release date, barcode, lowest and highest price in UAH, offers count, last recorded price, rating and rating per aspect, recommended and not recommended review counts, description, every specification (grouped), images, videos, variants (colour, memory...), similar and newer models and related categories, plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotline-product

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Product link or path on hotline.ua.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City for prices: kyiv (default), lviv, kharkiv, odesa, dnipro, zaporizhzhia or a numeric city id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
User reviews of a product on Hotline.ua: rating, ratings per aspect, recommended flag, confirmed purchase, usage period, text, pros, cons, helpful votes, images, videos and comments (brand representatives by name; users by first name and initial in `author` and by the name the page shows in `author_name`), plus the site's review summary. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

get.description:
Search Hotline.ua, Ukraine's price comparison site. Each product: id, title, link and path, brand, category, type, model line, lowest and highest price in UAH across shops, number of offers, reviews and questions, sales count, new flag, release date, short specifications, images, colours and the single shop when only one sells it, plus `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotline-search

Find shops on Hotline.ua by name: id, name, link, logo, active and closed flags, year founded. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hotline-shops-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
